about: Regions cut from Satie takes that contain more than one event. Each realized 'single' mallet take holds 3-4 separate thuds over 4 s, and two fold takes hold 2-3 slaps, so one strike played several. Regions were chosen from the loudness envelope: from just before the first impact to just before the next. scripts/prepare-takes.mjs applies them to satie/realized/samples.json (Satie's file, untouched) and writes public/satie/samples.json.

drop.reason: The user removed the crowd (2026-11-14); these clips belong to voices no longer in scene.satie.
